_comment: Workflow states for the PDF bills in this folder, used by `node scripts/seed.mjs --processed`. Days are relative to the day the seed runs (negative = in the past), so due dates stay realistic. Everything else (vendor, amount, invoice number, description) comes from bills.json, which stays the extraction answer key.

cedar-valley-bill.pdf.note: Please confirm whether the quarterly inspection covers the loading dock.

harborlight-bill.pdf.note: Billed for two alarm panels; the site has one.
